gbm_population_evidence.quote: A Phase 1 Trial of D2C7-IT in Combination With Atezolizumab in Recurrent WHO Grade IV Malignant Glioma
Prior histopathology confirmed recurrent supratentorial WHO grade IV malignant glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: Approximately eighteen patients with recurrent WHO grade IV malignant glioma will receive atezolizumab and D2C7-IT to determine the impact of the combination of D2C7-IT and atezolizumab on safety.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must have a recurrent supratentorial WHO grade IV malignant glioma based on imaging studies

role_evidence.quote: Single D2C7-IT convection-enhanced delivery (CED) infusion (6920 ng/mL) plus atezolizumab (1200 mg) intravenous (IV) infusions every three weeks for up to two years

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational dual-specific anti-EGFRwt/EGFRvIII antibody-based immunotoxin (D2C7 immunotoxin), intratumoral convection-enhanced delivery
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: a dual-specific monoclonal antibody (mAB) with a high affinity for both EGFRwt- and EGFRvIII-expressing cells

role_evidence.quote: This is a phase 1 study of atezolizumab in combination with D2C7-IT

coder_notes: Population is 'recurrent supratentorial WHO grade IV malignant glioma' without IDH requirement, coded gbm_only/historical per D27C (glioblastoma itself named only in keywords). Two experimental arms differ only in D2C7-IT dose (dose reduced after first 4 patients), so control_arm_from_other_arms = no. D2C7-IT is delivered intratumorally by convection-enhanced delivery via intracerebral catheter: coded new_route; device_dependent left false because CED is treated as a route rather than device activation/BBB-opening, but adjudicator may consider R4. EGFRwt/EGFRvIII mentioned only as the drug's target, not as an entry requirement or planned biomarker. MGMT promoter status appears in the exclusion criteria only to define required prior chemotherapy (treatment history), so not coded as a biomarker.
